messages:
simon-customer: Hey team — our March invoice (cust: acme-prod) shows ~18M tokens billed but the dashboard usage for the same period is ~12M. We suspect streaming responses + client disconnects causing over-counts. Example request id: req_8f4a. Can someone check?
jamie-support: Sorry about that Simon — we can dig in. Do you have an example request/approx timestamps? Also are you using SSE or long polling streams? :thinking_face:
simon-customer: SSE. Client library = acme/streamer v1.2. Happened repeatedly during a batch of 10k short queries (~40-150 tokens each). One sample curl we captured:```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=redwood-7b-v1 -d '{"prompt": "summary...","stream":true}'
```
jamie-support: Thanks. Can you paste a small fragment of the SSE frames (raw) and the exact client disconnect timestamp? A short excerpt is enough.
simon-customer: pasted raw SSE frames below (timestamps scrubbed):```

data: {"type":"delta","token_count":12,"text":"Hello"}

data: {"type":"delta","token_count":5,"text":" world"}

data: {"type":"delta","token_count":8,"text":"\.
More"}

data: {"type":"final","token_count":25,"text":"Hello world.
More"}

# client closed connection abruptly after the 3rd chunk (no final ack)
```
jamie-support: Hmm — interesting. Our metering pipeline consumes metering events emitted by the runtime. Normally we count the final event if present, otherwise we sum deltas. If both deltas and final are recorded for the same generation, double-counts can happen in corner cases. Looping in Rita (eng-runtime).
rita-eng-runtime: I see the sample. Two likely failure modes: 1) if the runtime emits per-chunk deltas to metering and later also writes a final aggregate record, and the reconciliation job doesn't dedupe by generation-id, you'll get the sum of both, or 2) if the client reconnects and the request is retried, partial tokens from aborted attempt + resumed attempt both get counted. Do we have generation ids in these events?
jamie-support: We do have generation_id: gen_9c3 in headers of the runtime events (Simon confirmed).
rita-eng-runtime: OK then dedupe should be possible. My hunch: for aborted streams (client disconnect) the runtime currently emits the last delta and then also emits a separate "finalized" record during cleanup which includes total tokens. If the cleanup runs after the per-chunk events have been pushed through the metering topic, both make it to billing. We'll need to confirm ordering guarantees in the pipeline.
alex-billing: From billing side: invoices are produced from the finalized metering store (BigQuery table). The dashboard reads a near-real-time table built from streaming ingest that has an event dedupe step but it's eventually consistent. That could explain dashboard < invoice numbers (invoice sees finalized aggregates + duplicates). We need to map the event ids. Can we get a sample of the metering messages (pubsub / kafka offsets)?
simon-customer: I can share a trace: topic=metrics-prod partition=4 offset_start=123456 offset_end=123470. gen_id=gen_9c3. I exported the messages and attached to the ticket.
nora-qa: I'll repro locally with a small harness: 1) open SSE, 2) stream 3 small chunks, 3) force TCP FIN from client after 2nd chunk, 4) let server cleanup. Test both with immediate cleanup and delayed cleanup. I'll run 1000 iterations and log metering events.
rita-eng-runtime: Thanks Nora. Test variants: a) runtime emits deltas only and emits final aggregate on cleanup b) runtime emits deltas and marks final as a tombstone (should dedupe) c) disable retries at proxy level so aborted attempts don't get retried. Also add an idempotency key check in the metering consumer to skip events with same generation_id+finalized flag if already applied.
jamie-support: Short-term workaround for customers: set client to send a streaming hint header `X-Redwood-Stream-Mode: conservative` (we added last month) which suppresses final-aggregate emission when deltas were already published. That reduces chance of double count. Share if you want me to flip that for acme-prod.
simon-customer: Please flip it for acme-prod while you investigate. Would appreciate invoice audit too — we are getting unexpected $3.2k delta.
alex-billing: Filed billing ticket #INC-4021 and started preliminary audit. If the dedupe proves to be the issue we can issue a credit for overbilled amounts and update invoice.
billing-bot: Invoice adjustment request created -> INC-4021. Status: awaiting engineering confirmation.
rita-eng-runtime: Quick note on root cause hypothesis: metering producer currently assigns event keys by generation_id but final aggregate uses a different key pattern (model+request_id). That prevents partition-level dedupe. I'll open a PR to standardize the key to generation_id and add a strict dedupe consumer that checks `generation_id + finalized` uniqueness.
jamie-support: Action items: 1) flip conservative header for acme-prod (done = no) 2) Nora to run repro and paste offsets 3) Rita to instrument consumer dedupe 4) Alex to hold invoice adjustments pending confirm.
simon-customer: Thanks all — appreciate the fast triage. Please post updates here.
jamie-support: Will follow up with status by EOD PST. :thumbsup:
